title: alyssum thymops
intro: Alyssum thymops, commonly known as Creeping Thyme or Thymus serpyllum, is a low-growing, spreading herb with tiny leaves and pink or white flowers. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Alyssum thymops include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. Bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
